channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Home-based learning for two schools near Kulai factory fire
item.description: KULAI: Two schools located near the rubber-processing factory that caught fire in the Sengkang industrial area here have implemented home-based teaching and learning (PdPR) as a precautionary measure following the incident.

item.title: Kelantan police urge vigilance after Kedah shooting
item.description: KOTA BARU: Police in Kelantan have urged enforcement officers to remain vigilant while carrying out their duties following a shooting incident in Kedah this morning.

item.title: Court overturns fine, jails trader for assaulting 70-year-old
item.description: SHAH ALAM: A 52-year-old trader who assaulted and threatened to kill an elderly man following a minor road accident near Taman Suntex will spend Hari Raya behind bars.

item.title: [UPDATED] Petros loses court bid to block RM7.95mil Petronas bank guarantee claim
item.description: KUCHING: The High Court here today dismissed a Petroleum Sarawak Bhd’s (Petros) application to challenge a bank guarantee claim made by Petronas amounting to RM7.95 million.

item.title: Security tightened at entry points after attempt on MCBA commander
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The government has activated additional security measures at all national entry points following an attempt on the life of the Bukit Kayu Hitam Malaysian Border Control and Protection Agency (MCBA) commander earlier today.

item.title: 37 university student deaths recorded over five years, Dewan Rakyat told
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: A total of 37 fatal incidents involving university students were recorded over a five-year period up to 2025, the Dewan Rakyat was told.

item.title: Cops arrest suspects over Second Link barrier ramming at Singapore Tuas checkpoint
item.description: SINGAPORE: Suspects wanted by Johor police for ramming the Second Link immigration barrier were arrested at the Singapore Tuas checkpoint on Feb 22 following a lockdown.

item.title: Nestlé Malaysia's Q4 net profit surges 205pct to RM125.5mil
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Nestlé (Malaysia) Bhd’s net profit soared 205.4 per cent to RM125.53 million in the fourth quarter (Q4) ended Dec 31, 2025 from RM41.1 million a year earlier.

item.title: Japan's military build-up reopens old wounds
item.description: JAPAN Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s plan to rearm in a big way is set to revive historical trauma, not reassurance in parts of Southeast Asia.

item.title: AmBank's Q3 net profit rises 8.9pct to RM529.6mil
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: AMMB Holdings Bhd’s (AmBank) net profit rose 8.9 per cent to RM529.58 million in the third quarter ended Dec 31, 2025 (Q3 FY26) from RM486.49 million a year ago, driven by improvements in net interest income and non-interest income.
